opening.argument: The presentation pairs a headline promising “+55% Profit Per Day” with step-by-step instructions to deploy an Ethereum trading bot, fund a contract, and start it. The description specifies a deposit of at least 0.2 ETH, while the speaker links larger deposits to larger transactions and accumulated profit. He then reports about 1.31 Ethereum as 31% profit and later says he reached a little over 1.6 Ethereum after about a day. These are presented as practical returns from the bot, not merely as an abstract explanation of trading. The speaker acknowledges that profits fluctuate, but the contract’s operation, reported returns, and recoverability of deposited funds are not verified. That limitation makes the concrete deposit instructions and unusually high return claims especially significant.

citations.quote: How to Make +55% Profit Per Day with an Ethereum MEV Bot
Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address
the more. You put in, the larger the transactions you will be able to sandwich and the more profit. You'll be able to accumulate over time.
It's a little over 1.6 Ethereum, so it basically took me a day to gain over half my deposit.
The profits will fluctuate week to week.
